title: Safe multi-robotic arm interaction via 3D convex shapes
core_idea: Develop an online collision-avoidance methodology for multiple robotic arms operating in shared space by constructing high-order control barrier functions (HoCBFs) for interactions between 3D convex shapes, using these HoCBFs as centralized or decentralized safety filters that integrate with nominal controllers and reducing per-constraint computational overhead (e.g., Hessian terms) via numerical differentiation approximations.
tldr: An online method for multi-arm collision avoidance that models robot links as 3D convex shapes and uses high-order control barrier functions as centralized or decentralized safety filters, with computationally expensive terms approximated numerically.
